correctness.rationale: PASS. Three UNORDERED points on the graph K(3,4) are modeled by the weight-three reduced Świątkowski complex, with chain dimensions (364,1326,1476,491). Independently reconstructed all basis monomials, full integer differentials and verified both compositions d^2=0 on every column. F2 boundary ranks are (363,956,491); F3 and F5 ranks (363,957,491). The known integral H1 rank six and connectivity, together with these lower bounds and Euler characteristic, force rational Betti vector (1,6,28,0). Reconstructed signed diagonal chain-action traces for all 144 group elements of S3 x S4, including local-half-edge basepoint changes and vertex wedge reordering. Alternating Lefschetz traces plus the graph-cycle H1 module give the stated seven H2 Specht constituents (one multiplicity two), H1 standard(3) tensor standard(4), and no positive-degree full-group invariants. F3 ranks are not misconstrued as integral torsion certification.
